newsitem.title: USA: Arvin to buy remaining stake in venture for $30 million.
newsitem.headline: Arvin to buy remaining stake in venture for $30 million.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc., a maker of automotive parts, said Wednesday it plans to purchase for $30 million the remaining 50 percent of a joint venture involving its European replacement auto exhaust business from Sogefi SpA.
The joint venture company, TESH, was established in 1993 between Arvin's Timax Exhaust System unit and Sogefi's Rosi S.A., based in France, and Ansa Marmitte S.p.A., based in Italy.
Operations of TESH, based in the Netherlands, were not previously consolidated on Arvin's balance sheet. On an annualized basis, TESH should add about $100 million to Arvin's sales, the company said.
